name: 6-Minute Walk Test
description: Distance walked in 6 minutes on a flat, hard surface. Higher distance is better. Requires 30-meter straight hallway.
shirleySays: ICC 0.94–0.99. MDC: 58 m (geriatrics), 36.6 m (chronic stroke), 54 m (COPD). MCID: 54–80 m (COPD); 50 m (geriatrics & stroke). Requires 30-meter straight hallway. Strong correlation with VO₂max (r=0.73).

scoring.mcidNote: 54–80 m (COPD); 50 m (geriatrics & stroke); normative: 60–69 yr M≈572 m, F≈538 m
